approach: Matching decompilation of the Allegrex (MIPS32r2) executable of Daxter for PSP: authored C/C++ that builds to a byte-identical copy of the retail executable.
help: reviewing the function candidates into a layout
notes: The visibility gate is passed: the ~PSP executable is decrypted by the project's own tool and measured. The game code is one monolithic, stripped PSP PRX of 3335156 bytes of code behind the ~PSP encryption; there is no symbol table, so the functions have no names and their boundaries are not established yet. The inventory holds 14655 frame-opening candidates, of which 8794 save the return address. No function has been matched.
